question: Approve DRC-4594 as delivered: Held to reordered so purpose and inputs precede the caveats?

artifacts.summary: GO. Review found a user-visible regression this change created: the reorder moved the observed record below a sentence asserting it was above, on the default no-reading-yet arm, measured at 4,241 characters apart on the implementer's own fixture. Both sentences were corrected to a true positional word rather than having the word removed, and the replacement oracle is direction-aware with a non-vacuity assertion, because dropping the word would have left a sweep that returns nothing and passes forever. That sweep then found a third instance nobody had looked for. AC-5's six-branch matrix collapsed twice - once exercising one arm, once exercising six copies of one arm through a stub lacking getAttribute - and now asserts the six shapes DIFFER, giving three distinct raise claims, two re-entry sentences and six distinct pairs against 1/1/1 before.
